title: Among customers who were active in October 2013 and belong to the LAM segme
question: Among customers who were active in October 2013 and belong to the LAM segment with EUR currency, what is the total number of high-value transactions (total price > 500) that occurred at gas stations in each country, and which country has the highest count?

prediction.sql:
SELECT T4."XCL_006" AS country, COUNT(T3."XCL_010") AS high_value_transaction_count
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T4 ON T3."XCL_015" = T4."XCL_004"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM'
  AND T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
  AND T2."XCL_020" = '201310'
  AND T3."XCL_018" > 500
GROUP BY T4."XCL_006"
ORDER BY high_value_transaction_count DESC
